title: NIFTY FMCG P/E Ratio
description: NIFTY FMCG stocks were valued at a P/E of 30.2 as of 29 Oct, 2026, reflecting pricing trends across India's consumer goods sector. FMCG valuations often move with rural demand cycles, input cost pressures, and consumption growth data.
